rows.grounds: direct object of the gerundive action; material to be taken
gerund expressing the act of taking the specified material
numeral qualifying the bark-essence as a single portion
compound specifying the measure of the portion to be taken

items.question: What specific material and measurement are prescribed to be taken in this ritual preparation?
premises: Bark-essence is the material to be taken.
Only one portion of this material is specified.
The prescribed measure of this portion is two and a half fingers.
items.inference: Therefore, one portion of bark-essence measuring two and a half fingers must be taken.
uncertainties: The exact practical interpretation of the finger-based measure in this ritual context is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: Indeed, having taken one portion of bark-essence, measuring two and a half fingers.
